coverage: 2000-present: 2011-present Governor executive-order archives (LePage and Mills), plus storm emergency proclamations from 2013-2024 taken from the Governor's proclamations and news releases; the adapter does not yet read the Mills proclamations listing. Plus declarations added by hand from official announcements, order text and dated news coverage, including Governor Baldacci's 2004-2010 weather emergency proclamations from the Maine State Library's yearly archives of his press releases. No state declaration has been found for Governor King's years: DR-1326 (spring 2000 flooding and ice jams), EM-3164 and DR-1371 (March 2001 snow and flooding) and DR-1468 (2002-2003 winter cold and frost); the State Archives' 1975-2000 proclamation collection on Digital Maine did not return his items. Nor for EM-3174, EM-3190 and EM-3194 (2003 snowstorms), EM-3209, EM-3210 and DR-1591 (March 2005 snow), EM-3265 (December 2005), DR-1716 (Oxford County, July 2007: declared, but no date found), DR-1788 (July 2008), DR-1852 (June 2009), DR-4367 (March 2018), DR-4647 (October 2021), DR-4696 (December 2022) or DR-4719 (spring 2023); Governor Mills's request letters for the last two describe activating the State Emergency Operations Center and mention no declaration
